name: Palestine
description: Palestine from Canaan and Jericho to the Romans, Arabs, Crusaders and Ottomans, the British Mandate, the Nakba, the occupation, Oslo and the war in Gaza.

checkpoints.name: Ancient Palestine
checkpoints.note: Jericho, Canaan, Israelite kingdoms, Romans, Byzantines, Arabs and Crusaders.

checkpoints.name: Ottoman and British rule
checkpoints.note: The Ottomans ruled for four centuries. Britain took the land in 1917 and ruled under a mandate.

checkpoints.name: Nakba and occupation
checkpoints.note: Some 700,000 Palestinians fled or were driven out in 1948. Israel took the West Bank and Gaza in 1967.

checkpoints.name: Oslo and after
checkpoints.note: The Oslo Accords set up the Palestinian Authority. Gaza fell to Hamas in 2007, and the war that began in 2023 destroyed most of it.
